name: walk-front
prompt: Production animation sheet of the exact USER-APPROVED mean vicious giant rat in the supplied reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT a layout to copy. Lean wiry quadruped, narrow angular muzzle, small narrowed predatory dark eyes, small rounded ragged ears, sharp natural rat incisors, coarse bristling brown-gray fur, muted pink-brown paws/ears and long bare segmented tail. Four paws only. Detailed shaded textured hand-painted retro dungeon game art; muted earthy palette, crisp edges, warm neutral light. Keep rat mean and nasty, never cute, fluffy, plump or baby-faced. FRONT view facing straight toward the viewer. Both eyes visible, symmetrical front paws; tail trails behind body. TWO full-body frames LEFT then RIGHT in a single horizontal row, two equal-sized cells, landscape sheet. WALK locomotion, not idle. Frame 1: near forepaw reaches FORWARD, near hindpaw pushes BACK; opposite diagonal pair support the weight. Frame 2: reverse the diagonal gait, near forepaw planted BACK and near hindpaw coming FORWARD, with opposite paws switched. Clear visible alternating four-legged walking stride. Each frame has visibly different paw positions and shoulder/hip angles. Body remains low at same size/height, nose points same direction, tail sways modestly. No duplicated identical standing frames. Each complete rat INCLUDING ENTIRE TAIL must fit inside its OWN cell with at least 12% transparent margin on every edge and a fully transparent gutter between cells; never overlap or touch. Keep body/paw registration stable. OPAQUE RAT ON GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND: every background pixel must have alpha 0. Absolutely NO colored brown haze, glow, vignette, gradient backdrop, floor or cast shadow. No text, labels, borders, grid lines or reference turnaround layout. Preserve source detail and complete whiskers, ears, paws and tails.
